title: Samsung S9 - Android 10 udate issues
symptom: After updating Samsung S9 to Android 10, using a Fossil Sport watch as collector, xDrip stops collecting data after a few minutes. It is no longer possible to disable Bluetooth; xDrip always enables it, and the collector only works if both Bluetooth and location are enabled, causing high power use.
cause: The thread does not identify a root cause; it describes behavior changes after Android 10 update but no explanation is given.
fix: No resolution is provided; the issue is closed due to inactivity.
evidence_quote: After update this is not possible. Before only BT have to be enabled. Now Location and BT have to be enabled.
